mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_post ( post_id, company_id, company_post_title, company_post_content, space_type, area_pyeong, style, construction_detail) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{companyId}, #{companyPostTitle}, #{companyPostContent}, #{spaceType}, #{areaPyeong}, #{style}, #{constructionDetail} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.post_date AS postDate, c.company_id AS companyId, c.company_post_id AS companyPostId, c.company_post_title AS companyPostTitle, c.company_post_content AS companyPostContent, c.space_type AS spaceType, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.style AS style, c.construction_detail AS constructionDetail FROM company_post c JOIN post p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE company_post_id = #{companyPostId}

SELECT company_id AS companyId, company_name AS companyName, company_intro AS companyIntro FROM company c JOIN company_detail d ON d.company_detail_id = c.company_detail_id WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
